# GPT-6.2 Astra: model guidance

Applies only to GPT-6.2 Astra. Read it with `providers/openai.md`; where an entry here disagrees with that file or with `general.md`, the entry here wins. Cite as `[ref: providers/openai/gpt-6-2-astra.md §<section>]`.

## Writing style

- More concise and direct by default than earlier models. Revisit "be concise" lines written for earlier models: they push an already short default further. Ask instead for the reader's context to be kept (terminology, background an outside audience needs).

## Frontend design

- When the interface needs a particular look, specify the imagery and typography (a typeface, when it matters), and keep interface copy to what people need to know or do.
